Welcome to Numbo, the little land where math is an adventure!
Behind the clouds lies a tiny land called Numbo. That is where Bobby lives, the keeper of numbers.
Every morning, Bobby lines up the numbers 1 to 9 on a favorite shelf. Everything is neat and cheerful!
Suddenly, WHOOSH! A big wind blows every number far away.
The numbers are hiding all over the land: in a garden, a river, a hill, a cave, an island, and a village.
Bobby cannot count without the numbers. Will you help Bobby?
Hooray! One by one, all the numbers are back on Bobby's shelf.
Thank you! You are now an official Number Keeper.
Thanks for playing Numbo. Come back any time. Bobby and the numbers will be waiting!
